github_cli.purpose: Owner-authenticated private repository and release downloads

git.purpose: Fresh clone and pinned code revision

production_dependencies.source_of_truth: Private host snapshot metadata/dpkg-packages.txt, metadata/systemd.json, metadata/uname.txt, captured lockfiles and binary hashes
production_dependencies.installation: Reconstruct on compatible Linux architecture using captured package/version evidence; preserve service ownership and mounts
production_dependencies.validation: Independent from isolated recovery validation; live host provisioning must be tested before service activation

provider_versions.other_providers: Use captured deployed binary hashes and manifests; no version is inferred from directory names
